fato_historico: 1964: Martin Luther King Jr. receives the Nobel Peace Prize for combating racial inequality through nonviolence.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a powerful moment to champion peace and justice in your own world. Much like a visionary honored for leading with love, you might find yourself inspired to resolve conflicts through gentle strength. It is a good time to reflect on your impact and consider how your unique passion can serve the greater good with grace.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the gentle courage to pursue peace above all else.
significado_numero: Represents the dynamic balance between action and reflective quiet wisdom.
conselho: Use your natural drive to build bridges and spread kindness wherever you go.
